authorization: User authorized choosing and documenting all conventions not specified by the project PDF.
parity_definition: Y = A0 XOR A1 XOR ... XOR A7; 1 means odd parity and indicates an error if the complete received eight-bit word is expected to have even parity.
bit_order: Circuit vector integer bit i drives Ai; displayed binary input_bits is A7..A0. Two-input gate input_bits is AB.
parity_limitations: No ninth parity input. Detects an odd number of flipped bits, not every multi-bit error. The output is combinational.
architecture: Balanced 7-XOR tree. Each XOR uses four NAND2 static-CMOS gates, so 28 NAND2 cells and 112 MOSFETs total.
sizing_rationale: Both widths lie inside the assigned training range; PMOS is twice NMOS width. Uniform device widths across all gate types. This is a reproducible leakage-study design, not a claim of optimized delay or balanced drive.
source_drain_geometry: AD/AS/PD/PS omitted consistently; assigned model and simulator defaults are retained. No layout parasitics are claimed.
primary_leakage: Total power supplied by all independent DC voltage sources divided by VDD. With rail-valued inputs this is -I(VDD) minus currents of input sources driven high.
primary_rationale: Includes gate tunnelling energy from input drivers and makes standalone-gate power additive under the brief's ideal-rail/no-loading approximation.
secondary_leakage: Supply-only -I(VDD), recorded separately for SPICE and ML.
ml_power: For each FET: P=(Vd-Vs)*Id+(Vg-Vs)*Ig+(Vb-Vs)*Ib. This explicitly closes source current as Is=-(Id+Ig+Ib). The four learned raw terminal currents remain available and their raw KCL residual is reported.
ml_voltage_provenance: Part B reuses the standalone gate's recorded SPICE terminal/node voltages, as required. Part C propagates ideal Boolean gate inputs and sums the matching Part B gate-model predictions at the same corner. No complete-circuit internal voltages enter ML.
bias: Mean signed prediction-reference in amperes; also mean signed relative error in percent.
mean_accuracy_percent: 100*(1-mean_absolute_relative_error), unbounded below and not clipped. 99% requires mean absolute relative error <= 0.01. R2 is reported separately.
gate_selection_policy: Gate and complete-circuit reference currents are evaluation-only and may not select or train transistor models. Models are selected on their designated transistor validation partitions.
